description: This Java source file defines the ChartHelper class, which provides utility methods for creating and configuring 3D surface plots and controls related to XY data visualization within a GUI. It handles UI components, surface model setup, and interaction logic for visualizing data in 3D plots.

classes.name: ChartHelper
classes.description: Utility class for creating GUI components for 3D surface visualization and managing surface models based on XY data.

methods.name: create3DControl
methods.description: Creates a JPanel containing a 3D surface plot with controls for saving the image and adjusting RPM and Y values.

methods.name: createDefaultSurfaceModel
methods.description: Overloaded methods to create DefaultSurfaceModel instances based on XYData, with optional x/y ranges and second data set.

methods.name: setYRange
methods.description: Sets the Y-axis min and max values of a surface model based on provided Range.
